extraction.Name: John Lee
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County (Pine Ridge area, South Dakota)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment, on account of not wishing to pay taxes; that he was told that he would have to take the patent and pay taxes, and he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged his half section for $396.00 to pay the taxes
extraction.Buyer: Mr. A. Barker, of Denby, South Dakota, holding and foreclosing the mortgage, which was foreclosed in 1924
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, and that he mortgaged his half section for $396.00 to pay the taxes
extraction.NOTES: Mentally incompetent; health is poor, being bothered especially with acute rheumatism; supported by a grown son; wife also supported by this same son; has never received any help from the County or Government; document No. 53; sworn November 15, 1928
